586-864-3125-5256-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5256-5477.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-4772-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

292-1495-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
292-1495-7803.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-7803.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1558-7748.description:
Deal combat damage using Ant-Man, triggering its ability, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2511-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2511-4302-4875.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4798-6462-7435.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4798-6462-7435.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers. Holding priority, activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

3358-4881-7297.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

719-2292-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2292-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5344-6349-6594.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5344-6349-6594.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

141-2562-5686.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

141-2511-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2511-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

1274-1874-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1874-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1796-4484-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-4484-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-4484-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1373-3946-6701.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2452-2577-5147.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2452-2577-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1548-3484-4636-6320.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}
1548-3484-4636-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Port Razer that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Port Razer token enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Port Razer token. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

38-301-2595.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
38-301-2595.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

2350-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1636-3490-4419.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
1636-3490-4419.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Intruder Alarm and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4050-5532.easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
3490-4050-5532.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
3490-4050-5532.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1641-2034-4452-4758.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2198-2232-2608-3084.notablePrerequisites: Aether Vial has exactly three charge counters on it.
2198-2232-2608-3084.description:
Activate Aether Vial by tapping it, putting Deceiver Exarch onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Aether Vial.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Derevi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Aether Vial by tapping it, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Aether Vial.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Deceiver Exarch from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

202-3139-4067.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to draw two cards due to Lich.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping The Great Henge.
Repeat.

1887-2615-4040.notablePrerequisites:
Sorin in hand.Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
Tree of Perdition has toughness less than or equal to thirteen.
1887-2615-4040.description:
Cast Sorin for {2}{B}{B}.
Sorin enters the battlefield with eight loyalty counters.
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, causing target opponent's life total to be swapped with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Activate Sorin's third ability by removing seven loyalty counters from it, causing the opponent to lose thirteen life and you to gain thirteen life.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2034-2367-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create a 1/1 Servo creature token.
Repeat.

1330-2615-4752.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
1330-2615-4752.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Into the Maw of Hell for {4}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing thirteen damage to Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.

3099-4131-4241.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
3099-4131-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

751-2757-3314.description:
Activate a basic Island you control by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Shrieking Drake, untapping a tapped basic Island.
Resolve Shrieking Drake's trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
